candidates.title: Hyderabad: 49 foreign nationals identified for overstaying, visa violations
candidates.excerpt: Hyderabad Police and the FRRO have identified 49 foreign nationals for allegedly overstaying or violating visa rules during a special verification drive. Twelve have been deported, while authorities are processing the remaining cases, police said, uncovering alleged drug and fraud-related activities

candidates.title: CM Revanth Reddy directs officials to prepare Child Online Safety Framework
candidates.excerpt: Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy directed officials to prepare a comprehensive Child Online Safety Framework to protect children from cybercrimes and ensure justice. He called for involving parents and highlighted Bharosa centres, SHE-Bharosa Cyber Labs and CybHER app initiatives.
